video_title: Exclusive: Bronny James is Ready for a BIGGER Role with Lakers 👀🔥 - Mason & Ireland

quotes.speaker: Bronny James
quotes.summary_phrase: Bronny James on his summer trip to Slovenia with teammates
quotes.excerpt: the Slovenia trip was great. Taking the time to get away, we had the Slovenia trip.

text_blocks.speaker: Steve Mason
text_blocks.text: Let's talk about the summer. How's your summer been?

text_blocks.speaker: Bronny James
text_blocks.text: Summer's been great. Taking the time to get away, we had the Slovenia trip. That was great.

quotes.speaker: Bronny James
quotes.summary_phrase: Bronny James on building team chemistry during the off-season
quotes.excerpt: that's the first step, me and new people and you got to work for them.

text_blocks.speaker: Steve Mason
text_blocks.text: I saw an interview that Ziaire Williams recently did. He talked about how he thought the bonding that you guys did in this off-season could translate onto the court. Do you agree and why?

text_blocks.speaker: Bronny James
text_blocks.text: I agree. That's the first step, me and new people and you got to work for them for the rest of the year. So I think it's good for us and it's going to be good for us going into the season too.

quotes.speaker: Bronny James
quotes.summary_phrase: Bronny James on his focus for improving his game
quotes.excerpt: I'm playing with Luka and AR still, so I'm going to be off-ball when it's needed.

text_blocks.speaker: Steve Mason
text_blocks.text: What aspect of your game are you focused on improving at this year?

text_blocks.speaker: Bronny James
text_blocks.text: I'm all across the board. I'm trying to get better. I'm playing with Luka and AR still, so I'm going to be off-ball when it's needed. I need to be able to knock down shots and create for others and I think I've been doing a good job with that this summer.

quotes.speaker: Bronny James
quotes.summary_phrase: Bronny James on his role as a secondary ball-handler
quotes.excerpt: I feel like I can be a secondary ball-handler to Luka and AR and generate whatever offense.

text_blocks.speaker: Steve Mason
text_blocks.text: What do you consider your offensive calling card? Because everyone's noticed the defense.

text_blocks.speaker: Bronny James
text_blocks.text: I feel like I can be a secondary ball-handler to Luka and AR and generate whatever offense and catch and shoots and pick and roll offense and stuff like that. So I pride myself in being an all-around player and whatever is needed, I'm up for it.
